AirTagHunter — download the APK from GitHub Actions
===================================================

Package: app.airtaghunter
Needs Android 10+ (API 29+).

This folder keeps the stock Fieldwatch signature catalog JSON used by unit tests
and Settings → Update stock catalog from GitHub. It does not ship a prebuilt
AirTagHunter APK.

Get AirTagHunter.apk
--------------------
1. GitHub → Actions → Android CI → latest successful run
2. Artifacts → airtaghunter-debug-apk → AirTagHunter.apk
3. Or Releases (after a v* tag)

Install
-------
Open AirTagHunter.apk from Files. Allow install from that app if asked.
Play Protect may warn that it is not from Play — expected for a debug build.

Before first launch: Location ON, Wi-Fi ON, Bluetooth ON.
Grant Location, Nearby Wi-Fi, Nearby devices / Bluetooth, Notifications.

New installs filter Live to Finder tags (BLE). Filters → All traffic shows everything.
Tap a detection → Hunt for relative RSSI while walking.

Fork notes: ../FORK.md
Upstream Fieldwatch: https://github.com/OffGridPete/Fieldwatch
